tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background in every app (warm sand, never pure white).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the entry keypad. Sits on bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, table stripes, chart tracks.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, drawers, modals above surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative, not a control edge).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons (3:1 on surface and bg).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts on bg, surface and sunken (15:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, dates on bg, surface, sunken and raised (5:1+).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Bleu Sidi Bou: the ecosystem colour. Logo, shared account screens (sign-in, profile, app switcher), links, focus ring. Not an app accent.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (8:1).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Brand tint: selected states in shared screens; brand text on it stays 6.7:1+.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The current app's accent. Each app aliases ONE accent-* token here. Primary button, active tab, the + button, progress.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (6:1+ for every accent-* in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The current app's accent tint: selected chip, active nav item, accent badge. Aliases the app's accent-*-soft.

tokens.name: accent-olive
tokens.usage: Olive: accent of the household expenses app.

tokens.name: accent-olive-soft
tokens.usage: Olive tint: selected chip, active nav pill; olive text on it 5.3:1+.

tokens.name: accent-terracotta
tokens.usage: Terracotta: reserved for a future app.

tokens.name: accent-safran
tokens.usage: Safran: reserved for a future app.

tokens.name: accent-lagune
tokens.usage: Lagune: reserved for a future app.

tokens.name: accent-figue
tokens.usage: Figue: reserved for a future app.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive outcomes and money in (income). Always with a sign or arrow, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success tint background; success text on it 4.5:1+.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Approaching a limit, unsaved changes. Pair with an icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning tint background; warning text on it 4.5:1+.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Over budget, destructive actions, errors. The ONLY red; never for ordinary spending. Pair with an icon or stripes.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger tint background; danger text on it 4.5:1+.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ring with a 2px gap, in every app.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Data/category colour 1 (orange). Chart marks and category dots; 4.9:1+ on surface in both themes. Always next to an emoji or label.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing, desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large separations, minimum touch target height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list groups, keypad keys.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, the dashboard tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the + button, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and drawers only. Cards use line, not shadow.
